title: Gorp Execution Graph
description: Source-neutral, runtime-neutral, provider-neutral authoritative execution graph. Multi-node graphs with dependencies are supported; execution state stores PROJECT IDENTITY ONLY — repository paths are resolved from the Gorp project registry at command time and are never persisted. Graph state semantics: every state change is an append-only transition record; 'cancelled' means AN OPERATOR ENDED THE GRAPH (all transitions to 'cancelled' are operator-only) — the transition's reasonCode says why (e.g. REVIEW_REJECTED when a rejection closes the graph); 'failed' is an execution failure recorded by orchestrator/system; 'completed' is reached only after promotion. No planning, scheduling, or decomposition semantics are implied by this schema.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bumped on any breaking change.

graphId.description: Stable explicit graph identity. MUST NOT be derived from a filesystem path.

baseCommit.description: Execution input: the git commit the graph was created against.

approvalStatus.description: Explicit approval boundary. File existence is NOT approval; only an operator transition sets this to approved.

nodes.description: Nodes execute one at a time in dependency order; multi-node graphs with dependencies are supported.

transitions.description: Append-only graph-level transition history (includes graph and node transitions).

stableId.description: Stable explicit identifier. No path separators; not derived from mutable filesystem paths.

isoTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Used only in event records, never as identity.

project.description: Project identity only. The repository path is resolved from the Gorp project registry (registry/projects.yml) at command time, never persisted here.

source.description: Optional free-text origin note (e.g. 'operator cli'). Never a provider or external tool authority.

actorType.description: Authorized transition actors. Workers are intentionally excluded.

taskType.description: Source-neutral task classifier (e.g. 'fixture-mutation'). Not tied to any runtime or provider.

allowedPaths.description: Write scope allow globs for the eventual worker.

forbiddenPaths.description: Deny globs; deny wins over allow (enforced by a later wave).

executable.description: Program to spawn (no shell, no whitespace splitting, no interpolation).

args.description: Exact argument vector; arguments may contain any characters including whitespace.

timeoutMs.description: Per-command timeout in milliseconds (default 600000). On expiry the command is killed and the check fails closed with the timeout recorded.

requiredCommands.description: Project check commands the gate runs inside the sandbox after the scope checks pass (Sprint 3C; structured executable/args form since Sprint 3D — no shell, no whitespace splitting). Any non-zero exit or timeout fails the gate; exit code, stdout, stderr, and duration are captured into the gate record. Promotion re-runs ALL of these against the reviewed commit and refuses to cherry-pick unless they pass again.

workerAdapter.description: Abstract worker adapter name (e.g. 'fixture'). MUST NOT name a concrete provider/runtime.

dependencies.description: Node dependency IDs. For a Wave-A executable graph this MUST be empty.

attempt.description: Execution attempt counter. 0 before any execution.
